newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile to keep searching for Colbun buyer.
newsitem.headline: Chile to keep searching for Colbun buyer.

text.p: Chile will not give up its search for a private "strategic partner" for power utility Colbun, despite spurning all bids in a privatization tender, the state companies authority CORFO said.
"CORFO maintains its decision to seek a private strategic partner for Colbun to strengthen the company and win an adequate compensation for the Treasury," said CORFO in a statement.
"For now, the company will continue its development without a private partner," it said.
CORFO issued the statement after announcing it rejected all bids for the 37.5 percent of the company up for sale, saying none of the offers were in line with Colbun's market value.
